rack.loc: pp. 14-15; ribbon size, row gap and rows of three from MCO 1020.34H (PDF pp. 136 and 142)
notes: Above-pocket gaps: MCJROTC handbook p. 14 paras 1d-1f.
Ribbon 3/8 inch high by 1 3/8 inch wide with a 1/8 inch gap between stacked rows: MCO 1020.34H, PDF p. 142, para 2. The handbook gives no size.
Rows of three, senior ribbon top and to the wearer right: MCO PDF p. 136. Handbook p. 15 para 2 gives the order only.
The handbook does not say how a short top row sits (topRow null) and lists no devices.

checklist.text: Shirt edge, belt buckle and trouser fly in one straight vertical line
Tie clasp centered between the 3rd and 4th button
Trouser bottoms even with the welt where heel and sole of the shoe join
Skirt length approximates the knee, not more than 1 inch above or below the center of the knee
Cover emblem wings parallel to the deck, anchor pointed forward
Collar emblems parallel to the deck, anchors pointed inboard
Ribbons 1/8 inch above and centered over the left breast pocket (1/8 inch above the badge if one is worn)
Only one marksmanship badge, the most recent qualification
Ribbons in order of precedence, senior on top and to the wearer's right
MCJROTC shoulder patch on the left sleeve
